phase1_leaf_result.part102_scope: Three official GitHub surfaces plus current connector action inventory and seven constructed probes: Git refs, commit statuses, and rulesets/protected refs.
phase1_leaf_result.new_positive_evidence: update_ref(force=false) remains useful as a local ref-concurrency/fast-forward fence for one ref transition.
phase1_leaf_result.new_falsification: 0/3 inspected GitHub-native alternatives satisfy all of: role-permitted without protected/admin/manual setup, zero finite quota/cost, and atomic {generation >= rollback-independent minimum AND effect_id unused} enforcement. Commit statuses also have a documented finite 1000-status-per-SHA/context limit; ruleset mutation needs admin/edit-rules authority; ref updates lack application generation-floor+effect-id atomic predicates and expose force=true rollback.
phase1_leaf_result.minimal_unresolved_child: A role-permitted Chat-native rollback-independent authority that atomically enforces a monotonic minimum generation plus single-use effect_id without protected/admin/manual setup, finite monthly/trial/paid quota, external hosted coordination, or incremental cost.

phase1_acceptance.scope_guard: Only Part102's named official GitHub surfaces, connector inventory, and seven constructed probes; no destructive mutation or generalization to undocumented/enterprise-only/external sink semantics.
